correctness.rationale: For the one-pole order-ten Artin–Schreier cover, ramification gives genus 9 and p-rank 0. Castelnuovo–Severi forces any automorphism to preserve the unique index-three rational subfield, and coefficient comparisons over algebraically closed characteristic-three fields force only the three deck translations. An explicit complete nine-dimensional differential basis yields Cartier ranks 4 and 5 according as a is zero or nonzero; the formula applies to every field parameter. Standard-library verify.py checks every displayed coefficient identity and sample finite-field cases, which are supporting rather than infinite-field proofs.

value.rationale: The new full family with constant minimal geometric group C3, fixed genus 9 and p-rank 0, but two exact a-numbers (5 and 4) gives a mathematically motivated partial answer to the 2026 explicit question about fine Jacobian invariants without extra automorphisms. Both values occur over the prime field, and the complete parameter jump locus is identified. This is a new natural invariant stratification, not just a normalized textbook exercise.
